scripts.build:check: bun run check && bun --filter @synapse/web build && bun run bundle:size
scripts.build:server:size: bun build apps/web/src/server/index.ts --outfile apps/web/.server-build/server.js --target bun --minify && bun scripts/bundle-size.ts --server
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun run test:all
scripts.test:all: bun run test:server && bun run test:api
scripts.smoke:release: JWT_SECRET=smoke-test-secret JWT_REFRESH_SECRET=smoke-test-refresh-secret API_RATE_LIMIT_MUTATION=1000 SMOKE_WARMUP_RUNS=0 SMOKE_RUNS=1 bun scripts/server-smoke.ts
scripts.typecheck: bun x tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && bun x tsc -p packages/ui/tsconfig.json --noEmit && bun --filter '@synapse/core' typecheck && bun --filter '@synapse/features' typecheck && bun --filter '@synapse/api' typecheck && bun --filter '@synapse/shared' typecheck && bun --filter '@synapse/sync' typecheck
